blocks.text: HOARDING CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Hoarding Cleanouts in Georgina

items.q: How much does a hoarding cleanout cost in Georgina?
a: Pricing is based on how many rooms are affected and how much sorting the belongings need — never on the property’s location. The figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: Is there really no extra charge for waterfront or cottage properties?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at a Keswick backyard and at a cottage on the shoreline — no distance fee, no seasonal surcharge, no exceptions.

items.q: We only see my parent's place a few times a year — is that going to be a problem when we explain the situation?
a: Not at all, and there’s nothing to explain. A lot of families notice things gradually over visits rather than living close by day to day, and that timeline never factors into how the crew handles the work.

items.q: Can you time the cleanout around when a cottage or waterfront property is actually accessible?
a: Yes — tell the crew your property’s seasonal rhythm at the walkthrough and the visit gets planned around it, at the same flat price as anywhere else.

items.q: What's the best way to clean out a hoarder's house?
a: Professional help, a clear plan, and patience. Going in without a strategy usually causes more distress than progress. The most effective approach sorts systematically — keep, donate, recycle, dispose — and moves at a pace the household can genuinely handle.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the household is pointed toward the right licensed specialist before the rest of the cleanout proceeds.

items.q: Can family members who live elsewhere stay updated without being present?
a: Yes. Photo updates and progress reports are available throughout, so family visiting only occasionally or coordinating from a distance can stay informed without needing to be on site.
